description: Bootstrap under healthy UDGM TX/RX conditions, then dynamically degrade SUCCESS_RATIO_TX immediately after RANGER_CODED_READY to isolate rekey resilience.
interpretation: UDGM SUCCESS_RATIO_TX is dynamically changed only after successful bootstrap; SUCCESS_RATIO_RX remains 1.0.
primary_question: Given a successfully established group, how resilient is static k-of-n rekeying to subsequent transmission-side radio degradation?
